title: Dating Aboriginal stone-walled fishtraps at Lake Condah, southeast Australia
authors: Gunditj Mirring Traditional Owners Aboriginal Corporation
version: Journal of Archaeological Science 39, 268–286; author-uploaded full-text extraction via Academia.
lineage: Original collaborative excavation and AMS chronology of feature F10, Muldoons. Publisher abstract and article sections 3.9, 4.1–4.3, Table 1 and conclusions reopened via https://www.academia.edu/16379574/Dating_Aboriginal_stone_walled_fishtraps_at_Lake_Condah_southeast_Australia . Direct mirror download returned 403; no original PDF/cache claimed. Charcoal/infill dates, not direct dates of stone. Sedimentary hiatus does not establish continuous use or regional chronology.
